description: An HTML webpage sample for configuring CKEditor to output HTML compatible with Adobe Flash. Includes scripts, styles, and embedded JavaScript code to initialize CKEditor with specific settings and behaviors for Flash output.

methods.name: configureFlashOutput
methods.description: Adjusts the CKEditor dataProcessor to match Flash expectations, setting rules for HTML element output, formatting, and attributes.

methods.name: sendToFlash
methods.description: Retrieves the current data from CKEditor, modifies the HTML for Flash compatibility, and passes it to the embedded Flash object.
